The Oracles Project X.Y.Z for PLATFORM, a port of Oracle of Ages and Oracle of Seasons.
You need your own ROM of Oracle of Ages or Oracle of Seasons (US), and for a fan game its BPS patch; none is included.
First launch: open the launcher, pick a game, choose your ROM on its Cartridge page (Choose ROM...), then Play.
Updating: put the new version in place of this one; your saves, beside your ROMs, and your settings are kept.
Manual: https://github.com/thibautbus/top/blob/main/docs/PLAYING.md
MIT licence; the licences of the fonts, SameBoy, mGBA (with its notice and its one patch), inih, Lua and SDL 3 it embeds are in the files that come with it.
